verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI325X is a GPU accelerator with an open-source software stack (ROCm) that customers run on their own infrastructure. Opting out of training on user data is a policy for hosted AI services that collect user data, so it is a category error for a hardware accelerator. Nothing in the evidence shows AMD collecting customer data through the product, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
